# Ideal customer profile

## Who we sell to

Lenders and banks in North America that underwrite small business credit and
still do most of that work by hand, from about forty people up to a few
thousand.

## Segments

### Fintech lenders

Online lenders of fifty to four hundred people that make small business loans
in days rather than weeks. Their credit teams are small and measured on how
many applications they clear each week.

### Regional banks

Banks with one to twenty billion dollars in assets that lend to businesses in
their own region. They move slower than a fintech and buy after a quarter of
review by the chief credit officer.

### Credit unions

Member owned credit unions that have started lending to the small businesses
their members run. Most have one or two people who do all of the commercial
lending.

## What they share

Each of them underwrites a small business loan from bank statements and tax
returns read by hand, and each of them loses good applicants to whoever says
yes first.
